summary: Server crash while loading Superflat world based on Rails java.lang.StackOverflowError: Exception while updating neighbours
description: Steps to reproduce - Create new world - More world options - Worldtype: Superflat - Customize - Presets - Enter preset - minecraft:rail - Server will crash while loading the world Same crash occurs when using the minecraft:repeater preset, just after first player interaction with one of the repeaters. Stacktrace Encountered an unexpected exception z: Exception while updating neighbours at net.minecraft.server.MinecraftServer.b(SourceFile:886) at net.minecraft.server.MinecraftServer.a(SourceFile:822) at faq.a(SourceFile:96) at net.minecraft.server.MinecraftServer.x(SourceFile:688) at net.minecraft.server.MinecraftServer.a(SourceFile:270) at java.base java.lang.Thread.run(Thread.java:831) Caused by: java.lang.StackOverflowError at java.base java.lang.ClassLoader.defineClass1(Native Method) at java.base java.lang.ClassLoader.defineClass(ClassLoader.java:1010) at java.base java.security.SecureClassLoader.defineClass(SecureClassLoader.java:150) at java.base jdk.internal.loader.BuiltinClassLoader.defineClass(BuiltinClassLoader.java:855) at java.base jdk.internal.loader.BuiltinClassLoader.findClassOnClassPathOrNull(BuiltinClassLoader.java:753) at java.base jdk.internal.loader.BuiltinClassLoader.loadClassOrNull(BuiltinClassLoader.java:676) at java.base jdk.internal.loader.BuiltinClassLoader.loadClass(BuiltinClassLoader.java:634) at java.base jdk.internal.loader.ClassLoaders AppClassLoader.loadClass(ClassLoaders.java:182) at java.base java.lang.ClassLoader.loadClass(ClassLoader.java:519) at bwq.a(SourceFile:361) [...] Server crash log has been included as attachment.
Steps to Reproduce:
1. Launch Minecraft.
2. Create a new world via "Create New World".
3. Select "More World Options" during world creation.
4. Set the "World Type" to Superflat.
5. Click on "Customize" and navigate to the "Presets" tab.
6. Enter `minecraft:rail` as the preset configuration.
7. Save and load the new Superflat world.
8. Observe that the server crashes while loading the world.

Alternative Steps for Repeater Preset:
1. Launch Minecraft.
2. Create a new world via "Create New World".
3. Select "More World Options" during world creation.
4. Set the "World Type" to Superflat.
5. Click on "Customize" and navigate to the "Presets" tab.
6. Enter `minecraft:repeater` as the preset configuration.
7. Save and load the new Superflat world.
8. Interact with one of the repeaters in the world.
9. Observe that the server crashes after player interaction with the repeater.
Environment: Minecraft Java Edition Versions: 1.17.1 Release Candidate 1, 1.17.1, 1.18, 1.18.1
Observed Behavior: When attempting to load a Superflat world with the preset `minecraft:rail`, the server crashes due to a `java.lang.StackOverflowError`. This error occurs during the process of updating neighbors and is triggered by an exception while loading the world. Similarly, using the `minecraft:repeater` preset results in a crash immediately after the first player interaction with one of the repeaters. The stack trace indicates that the issue arises from the method `net.minecraft.server.MinecraftServer.b`, leading to an unexpected exception due to updating neighbors. Specifically, the error is caused by a `java.lang.StackOverflowError` originating from the class loading mechanism within the Java runtime environment. This problem persists and can be consistently reproduced by creating a new world with Superflat settings, selecting either of the problematic presets, and initiating the world load or player interaction as described. The server crash log has been included as an attachment to provide further details for developers to diagnose and resolve this issue.
Expected Behavior: When creating a Superflat world using the preset `minecraft:rail` or `minecraft:repeater`, the server should load the world without crashing. Players should be able to interact with rails and repeaters normally without causing any exceptions or stack overflow errors, ensuring stable gameplay.
